text: 1. Purpose and Scope

LiftedPath Empowerment Foundation ("LiftedPath", "we", "our" or "us") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal information entrusted to us. The purpose of this Privacy Policy (the “Policy”) is to explain the types of personal information that LiftedPath Empowerment Foundation (“LiftedPath”, “we”, “us” or “our”) may collect when you visit or use our website, located at Liftedpathfoundation.org (the “Website”), and how that information may be collected, used and disclosed. We are committed to respecting your privacy and protecting the personal information entrusted to us. We handle personal information responsibly and in accordance with applicable privacy and data protection laws. In addition to personal information, LiftedPath may collect other types of information, including technical and website usage information, to support the operation, security and improvement of the Website. By accessing or using the Website, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Policy. Where consent is required by applicable law, we will seek your consent for the collection, use and disclosure of your personal information as described in this Policy.
2. Collection of Personal Information

When visiting or using our Website, you may voluntarily provide us with certain personal information. For example, this may occur when you submit an enquiry through the “Contact Us” form or send us an email requesting information about LiftedPath Empowerment Foundation. We collect and use the information you provide to respond to your enquiries, share relevant information and provide the assistance or services you have requested. Depending on how you interact with us, the information we may collect includes:
A. Information submitted through our contact form
When you contact us through our website, we may collect:

items: Your name.
Email address.
Telephone number, where provided.
The contents of your message or enquiry.
Any other information you voluntarily provide.

text: B. Donation information

When you make a donation to LiftedPath, we may receive or process information necessary to acknowledge, verify and account for the donation. For bank transfers, this may include your name, payment reference, amount transferred and transaction confirmation details. For donations made through Paystack, payment transactions are processed by Paystack. We do not intend to collect or store your complete payment card details on our website.
C. Technical information
When you visit our website, certain technical information may be collected automatically, depending on the website configuration and services in use. This may include:

items: Internet Protocol (IP) address.
Browser type and device information.
Website pages visited.
Date and time of access.
Basic website usage and diagnostic information.

text: 3. How We Use Your Information
We use personal information for legitimate organisational and administrative purposes, including:

items: Responding to questions, messages and enquiries.
Communicating with donors, supporters, volunteers and partners.
Acknowledging and verifying donations.
Maintaining financial and administrative records.
Managing and improving our website.
Protecting our website against spam, fraud and unauthorised access.
Meeting applicable legal, regulatory and reporting obligations.

text: We will not use your personal information for purposes unrelated to those for which it was collected without an appropriate lawful basis.

5. Lawful Basis for Processing
We process personal information in accordance with applicable data protection laws. Depending on the circumstances, our lawful basis for processing may include:
Consent: Where you voluntarily provide information or agree to a particular use of your personal information.
Legitimate interests: Where processing is reasonably necessary for our legitimate organisational activities and does not override your fundamental privacy rights.
Legal obligations: Where we are required to retain or disclose information to comply with applicable laws and regulatory requirements.

Contractual necessity: Where processing is necessary to fulfil an agreement or take steps at your request. Where we rely on consent, you may withdraw it, subject to applicable legal requirements and any other lawful basis for retaining or processing the information.
5. Sharing of Personal Information

We do not sell, rent or trade personal information. We may share relevant information with trusted third-party service providers where necessary to operate our website, process donations or carry out essential administrative functions. These may include:
Paystack: To securely process online donations and payment transactions.
Website hosting and technical service providers: To host, maintain, secure and support our website.
Website communication providers: Where necessary to deliver or manage messages submitted through our contact form.

Professional advisers and regulatory authorities: Where disclosure is required by law or reasonably necessary to protect our legal rights. Third-party service providers are expected to handle personal information in accordance with applicable privacy and security requirements.
6. International Transfers of Personal Information

Although LiftedPath currently operates its programmes in Nigeria, some of the third-party services we use may process or store information outside Nigeria. For example, payment processing, website hosting and technical support providers may operate servers or services in other countries. Where personal information is transferred outside Nigeria, we will take appropriate steps to ensure that such transfers comply with the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 and applicable cross-border data transfer requirements.
7. Data Retention

We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was collected, including administrative, financial, legal and regulatory requirements. Contact form enquiries may be retained for as long as necessary to respond to the enquiry and maintain relevant communication records. Donation and financial records may be retained for the period required by applicable financial, accounting and regulatory obligations. When personal information is no longer required, we will take reasonable steps to securely delete, destroy or anonymise it, subject to applicable legal retention requirements.
8. Information Security

We take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect personal information against unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration, loss or destruction. These measures may include appropriate access restrictions, website security measures, secure payment processing through third-party providers and responsible handling of information by authorised personnel. However, no method of electronic transmission or storage can be guaranteed to be completely secure. We therefore cannot guarantee absolute security of information transmitted through the internet.
9. Cookies and Website Technologies

Our website is built using WordPress. Depending on the website configuration, WordPress, website plugins and third-party services may use cookies or similar technologies. Cookies are small files stored on your device that help websites function, remember preferences and, where enabled, analyse website usage. We may use strictly necessary cookies to support essential website function s. Other cookies, including analytics or marketing cookies, may be used if enabled on our website. You can manage or disable cookies through your browser settings. However, disabling certain cookies may affect website functionality. Where required by applicable law, we will seek consent before using non-essential cookies or tracking technologies.

13. Access to Personal Information, Questions and Concerns

You are responsible for notifying LiftedPath Empowerment Foundation in writing of any changes or updates to the personal information you have previously provided to us to ensure that our records remain accurate and up to date. You may request access to the personal information we hold about you or ask us to correct any information that is inaccurate, incomplete or outdated. Such requests should be submitted in writing using the contact details provided below and should include sufficient information to help us identify you and locate the personal information concerned. To protect your privacy and prevent unauthorised access to personal information, we may request additional details or documentation to verify your identity and confirm the nature of your request before proceeding. If you have any questions, concerns or complaints regarding this Privacy Policy or how LiftedPath Empowerment Foundation collects, uses, stores or protects your personal information, you may contact our designated Privacy Representative using the contact information provided below. Our Privacy Representative is responsible for overseeing our privacy practices and addressing enquiries relating to the handling and protection of personal information.
14. Children's Privacy

LiftedPath's work includes educational initiatives and programmes that may benefit children and young people. We recognise the importance of protecting children's personal information and handling it with particular care. We do not intend to collect children's personal information through our general website contact form as a routine practice. Where personal information relating to a child is required for an authorised programme, scholarship, educational initiative or other organisational activity, we will take appropriate steps to ensure that the collection and use of such information comply with applicable laws, including obtaining parental or legal guardian consent where required. We are committed to treating the personal information of children with dignity, confidentiality and respect.
15. Third-Party Websites

Our website may contain links to external websites, social media platforms or third-party services. These websites operate independently and may have their own privacy policie s and practices. LiftedPath is not responsible for the privacy practices, content or security of external websites. We encourage visitors to review the privacy policies of any third-party websites they access.
